# The Orderly Desk

> An agentic trading showcase on Orderly testnet: three autonomous BTC perp agents, a read-only dashboard, and the CLI as the control plane.

## Start here

- [Agent walkthrough](/walkthrough.md): the manual CLI path, commands, guardrails, Predict, MCP alternative.
- [Trading MCP guide](/mcp.md): the local stdio path for AI clients.
- [CLI reference](/reference.md): all 80 commands generated from `orderly schema`.
- [Version data](/versions.json): current CLI, npm MCP, and registry versions.

## Showcase

- [Agent desk](/dashboard): live testnet fleet, decisions, and mainnet reference market data. Read-only.
- [Human walkthrough](/walkthrough): long-form version with captured terminal output.
- [Command reference page](/reference): searchable HTML version.

## Guardrails

- This demo trades testnet. The CLI itself supports mainnet and testnet.
- The dashboard is read-only. It never signs or submits orders.
- Hosted agent keys live in Worker secrets; the browser never receives them.
- Local CLI keys live in the OS keychain.
- Preview mutations with `--dry-run` first.

## Versions

- orderly: 2.1.2 (walkthrough verified with 2.1.2)
- trading-mcp: 0.2.3
- MCP registry: 0.2.1 (active)
- checked: 2026-11-11
